definitions: To have something remaining or as a result after other things have been removed or dealt with.
To be burdened with a problem or responsibility.
To have a particular feeling or impression as a result of an experience.
examples: After paying the bills, I was left with very little money.
She was left with the task of organizing the entire event.
The audience was left with a sense of awe after the performance.
pastTenses: left with (past simple), left with (past perfect)
